Params: The shaking and roaring underfoot do not let up. Fractures climb the walls and reach across the ceiling.
A dark red glow pushes through the cracks, staining all three of your faces an alien color.
Across the walls, across the floor, across the ceiling, the Red Tide pulses like the blood of the dead leviathan flooding back into its guts.
She still looks dazed, but she forces her legs to keep moving.
My M.I.N.D... it's resonating with something in this place.
But the deeper we go, the more I remember.
Her eyes are stretched wide, her pupils unfocused in the stuttering light. She looks like she is trapped inside a waking nightmare.
"...the list of people I can trust has grown very short... you are the safest choice."
"...the list of people I can trust has grown very short... you are the safest choice."
"...entrust the remaining half of the "Understanding" ██ to the Spelmins..."
"...entrust the remaining half of the "Understanding" ██ to the Spelmins..."
She heaves as if retching, a stream of unintelligible words spilling out without pause. Then she gulps for air.
Leia's hands are there in an instant, catching Helentine as her strength gives out.
Half... half of the "Understanding"... What does that mean?
Half of the "Understanding" ██, and something else...
She shakes her head in agony, straining to bring the blurred memories into focus... When she finally speaks, her voice is thick with disbelief and a strange, unfamiliar weight.
That familiar, weighty word strikes you like a blow.
But there is no time to think. A humanoid shape congeals from the dark crimson liquid, pulling itself upright from the "blood" before lunging at the three of you.
It has not yet fully formed. Dark red fluid still drips from its unfinished limbs.
Her light whip snaps around the creature's torso. A sharp, brutal swing and it bursts against the wall, dissolving into red fluid that seeps back into the greater tide.
Helentine, we need directions! This place keeps shifting. I can't tell what's where anymore!
Shaking off the grip of memories that were never hers, Helentine pushes herself up and raises her buzzsaw to cut a way forward.
Hold on... shouldn't we be pulling back? Isn't that the way we came?
The Red Tide's already bleeding in from that direction. We can't double back now.
Follow me. The core sits on higher ground, and...
I can feel it. Wherever the Sefirah is, it's safe.
Why "Understanding"? Why only half? How did the Sefirah end up in Tavis' hands...? There is no time left to untangle these questions. The priority now is getting the three of you out alive.
We stay put, we get boxed in.
Let's push forward and break through.
Shielded by the light whip, the spider silk, and the roaring buzzsaw, your group turns and presses deeper into the Red Tide.
Between skirmishes, you open your terminal and try to raise Gray Raven and military command.
A Red Tide Projection lunges from the flank. A thread of spider silk arcs out and drags it into the dark.
Leia's light whip snaps around a newly formed projection. The recoil shudders up her arm.
Helentine's buzzsaw screams, opening a seam through the tide.
On the walls, projections melt into one another, a mass of individual terrors becoming a single looming thing.
A series of short, ominous clicks, followed by nothing but the shriek of static in the earpiece—
He's got too many Diplomatic Court officials here today. He won't give Babylonia an opening until he's gotten what he wants—
The Red Tide Projections close in from every direction. The walkway narrows with each step.
At the front, Helentine's buzzsaw tears through the projections, leaving a trail of dark, jagged light.
Behind them, Leia's whip cracks, and the projections go spinning off into the dark below, one after the next.
A thunderous roar fills the air, and a Red Tide colossus the size of a building comes crashing toward you.
Helentine's grip tightens, sudden and fierce, and she hauls you aside.
In the next breath, a red flood explodes through the side corridor.
Almost at once, light fractures and spills, and from every wall, gleaming streams of data flood the air.
They spread like foam, swelling to fill every visible space.
Something deeper is at work. The part of Helentine's M.I.N.D. that resonates with this thing is being drawn in.
The instant the anomaly registers, a survival instinct forged in past crises drives you to rapidly reinforce the M.I.N.D. link with Helentine. A split second later—
Amid a deafening roar, half your field of vision is devoured by this strange, churning color.
